name: 402cron
summary: Scheduled HTTPS delivery for agents: prepaid delivery packs over x402 (USDC on Base) call a registered URL on a cron schedule with a signed request.
description: Registers a public https URL and cron schedule, then attempts deliveries; each attempt consumes one prepaid delivery credit. Free pricing JSON 2026-11-09: trial 20 deliveries for $0.02 USDC; starter 2,000 for $1; month 50,000 for $25; packs never expire; balance counted in deliveries. MCP https://402cron.com/mcp: free tools get_pricing, get_docs, get_service_status; task management tools need a management token after purchase. Also documents A2A receptionist and OpenAPI. Vendor-affiliated (#34, paranormalen2). Shared operator with AISkills402, 402registry and 402post. Caveat: the product performs outbound HTTPS calls to URLs you register (network side effects). Real USDC; verified via free docs/MCP/pricing only.

agent_access.notes: x402 USDC on Base for packs; free pricing/docs/status MCP tools. Task tools need management token after purchase (not obtained during verification).
